meta.name: paper-analysis-assistant
meta.description: 根据arXiv论文网址自动下载PDF并进行多维度分析，包括文本提取、词频分析、语音播报、播客对话生成、交互式网页、PPT、总结图和引用分析

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析论文并生成总结、播客和PPT
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解arXiv论文并制作汇报材料
copy.tagline_en: Automatically analyze papers and generate summaries, podcasts, and PPTs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand arXiv papers and create presentation materials

howto.what: Claude可根据arXiv论文网址下载PDF，提取文本、统计词频、生成语音播报、双人播客对话、交互式网页、PPT、总结图及引用列表；也可直接处理PDF或按需只做部分分析。
howto.when: 当你提供arXiv论文网址或上传PDF文件时触发；只要求部分分析时按需执行对应步骤。

say.text: 只要这篇论文的词频统计和引用列表
say.note: 只执行对应的分析步骤。

say.text: 把这篇论文生成PPT和总结图
say.note: 会输出演示文稿和PNG总结图。

howto.what_en: Claude can download a PDF from an arXiv URL, extract text, analyze word frequency, generate speech audio, a two-person podcast dialogue, an interactive webpage, a PPT, a summary image, and a reference list. It can also process a provided PDF or run only selected analyses on demand.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an arXiv paper URL or upload a PDF file. If you request only partial analysis, Claude runs only the relevant steps.

say_en.note: Downloads the PDF and produces multiple analysis outputs.

say_en.text: I only need the word frequency and reference list of this paper.
say_en.note: Runs only the corresponding analysis steps.

say_en.text: Generate a PPT and a summary image for this paper.
say_en.note: Outputs a presentation and a PNG summary image.
